title: Jensen Huang Said to Have Had Relationship With Nvidia Executive Who Reports to Him
summary: Mr. Huang, Nvidia’s chief executive, is already facing scrutiny over an affair with a Chinese businesswoman who U.S. intelligence determined was a Chinese spy.
